name: 36 Week
source:
36 Week is an 18+ visual novel about a young man who signs a deal with a succubus — and must fulfill its terms before the countdown runs out.

The terms are simple: he must ejaculate with a person he’s known for at least a week. The people around him make sure it is anything but simple.
